description: Documented exceptions to the internal consistency check in code/verify_quotes.py, which asks whether each evidence quote appears verbatim in the quote field of the card result it points to. Of the 133 evidence entries in extraction/derived/cost-tags-129.json, 118 pass and the 15 entries below do not, for the reasons given: ten are pre-revision card-text traces and five are recon-9 additions whose quote is a different, also verbatim, sentence of the same paper. Every one of the 15 was separately verified against the source text under the two tests in tools/quote_audit.py (coverage and digit-by-digit numbers), so each is a traceability gap on the card side, not a fidelity gap on the source side. Nothing in this manifest changes any count: every listed entry still has has=true on its card.

The quote is a diagnostic sentence in the source's results discussion (Sec. 4.4, table on executor behaviour after source-authority gating) and verifies verbatim against fulltext/2609.01836v1.txt, but it is not one of the card's eight registered result entries. Registering it as a result would change the 1,077 result total, so it is kept as a locator-anchored reading and disclosed here.
